warm_up: one discarded invocation per configuration, plus >= 0.7 s of untimed copies inside every invocation
expert_size_note: mean bytes per expert over the 40 trunk layers (model-sizes.json); layers range from 1769472 to 2039808 bytes

link.note: pcie.link.gen/width.current from nvidia-smi at 2 Hz. The link downshifts at idle (Gen1 in P8), so only the 'during' histogram says what transfers ran at.
